expected_dmg.formula: 60 * hand_line_count  (hand_line_count = number of {Honedge=1065, Doublade=1066, Aegislash=1067} cards revealed from hand; reveal does NOT consume them)
230 flat; side-effect: user cannot attack next turn (self-lock)
150 flat; user takes 30 less next turn

early.until: turn <= 2 AND Aegislash not yet in play
early.on_plan: Honedge in play >=1; hand_line_count >= 2; first_attack_turn <= 3 (Doublade 120+ or Cut); Metallic Signal fires each turn

mid.until: Aegislash in play >=1 OR loaded Doublade (>=2 energy); hand_line_count >= 2
mid.on_plan: KO every turn (120-230); two loaded attackers maintained; ammo kept in hand; Boss's used to snipe

late.on_plan: Metal Slash 230 on 2-prize targets; gust for lethal; stop digging to avoid deckout; Genesect ex kept as wall not exposed active

doctrines.name: A_Aegislash_bigswing
doctrines.plan: Rare Candy Honedge->Aegislash; Metal Slash 230 / Slash 80 as primary; Doublade & Genesect support
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share[1067] high AND play_rate[1067] high AND 230/80 damage events dominate

doctrines.name: B_Doublade_handscale_swarm
doctrines.plan: Stay on Stage1 Doublade; hoard Honedge/Doublade/Aegislash in hand; Weaponized Swords 120-180 repeatedly at 2C; single-prize cheap attackers
doctrines.discriminating_metric: play_rate[1066] high AND sustained hand_line_count>=2 AND 120/180 damage events dominate AND energy_attach_share[1066] high

tensions.balance: keep hand_line_count >= 2 as reveal ammo; only play line cards beyond that into board/evolution
use Metal Slash only when it KOs OR a 2nd attacker is loaded to cover the lockout turn; else Slash 80 / Doublade
dig until pieces assembled, then stop; never fire Ultra Ball/Lillie's while hand_line_count < 2
use Metallic Signal from bench; send Genesect ex active only as a designated wall

hypotheses.claim: Weaponized Swords (display 0) is invisible to L0, so Doublade is never fed energy, never attacks, and gust/lethal/promotion ignore its real damage (60*hand_line_count).
hypotheses.direction: Doublade should receive energy and attack when it is the on-board attacker with hand_line_count>=2; its expected_dmg must equal 60*hand_line_count, not 0

threshold.value: energy_attach_share[1066] >= 0.20 and play_rate[1066] >= 0.5 in Doublade-doctrine games

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing energy onto Doublade can starve Aegislash Metal Slash lines when the KO tier is what's needed

hypotheses.claim: Ultra Ball (discard 2) fires unconditionally and discards sword-line cards (Doublade ammo) or Rare Candy / evolution pieces, directly cutting Doublade damage and evolution.
hypotheses.direction: Ultra Ball must NOT discard {1065,1066,1067} or Rare Candy while they are needed (hand_line_count would drop below ammo floor)

threshold.value: 0 Ultra Ball activations that reduce hand_line_count below 2

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-gating Ultra Ball stalls the search engine and slows setup / bricks early hands
hypotheses.scenario: Hand = {Doublade, Doublade, Rare Candy, Aegislash, Ultra Ball, Metal Energy}; Honedge active with 2 energy. L0 fires Ultra Ball, discards 2 -> discards Doublade+Aegislash (ammo & KO piece). Next turn Weaponized Swords does 60 instead of 180 and Aegislash line is dead.

hypotheses.claim: Lillie's Determination shuffles the whole hand into the deck; if fired while ammo (line cards / Rare Candy combos) is stockpiled, it destroys the Weaponized Swords setup.
hypotheses.direction: Lillie's must only fire when hand_line_count <= 1 (no ammo being held)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never firing Lillie's forfeits its 6/8-card refill when the hand is genuinely stuck
hypotheses.scenario: Hand = {Aegislash, Doublade, Doublade, Honedge, Metal Energy} (hand_line_count=4, 240 ammo ready), 5 cards so L0's <=5 draw gate triggers Lillie's -> entire ammo shuffled into deck; Doublade next turn reveals 0-1 -> 0-60 damage.
hypotheses.pattern: possession-based fire gate (replace generic hand-size threshold)

hypotheses.claim: Metal Slash (230 display, highest) is spammed on the same Aegislash; its self-lock ('can't attack next turn') causes every-other-turn attacking (ping-pong).
hypotheses.direction: after a Metal Slash, the next turn's attack should come from a different loaded attacker; nonattacking_turn_rate should stay low
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: banning Metal Slash unless a 2nd attacker exists can forgo a needed 230 one-shot KO
hypotheses.pattern: reserve 2nd loaded attacker; use burst attack only when KO or backup loaded

hypotheses.claim: Energy is attached by count not type, so Dark(7)/Enriching(13) (Colorless-only) land on Metal-cost attackers (Metal Slash needs 1M, Protect Charge needs 2M), leaving them unable to attack.
hypotheses.direction: the Metal (8) energy should be prioritized to fill the M requirement of Metal Slash / Protect Charge before C-only energy

threshold.value: Genesect/Aegislash reach M-requirement without stalling in >=90% of loaded-turn cases

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-hoarding Metal for M slots can leave C slots unpaid and delay any attack
hypotheses.pattern: type-aware loading (fill M slots with Metal)

hypotheses.claim: Genesect ex (2-prize) gets loaded and pushed to the active spot as an attacker; when KO'd it hands the opponent 2 prizes and collapses the favorable single-prize trade structure.
hypotheses.direction: Genesect ex should stay benched running Metallic Signal; it goes active only as a wall, not as the default attacker
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never using Protect Charge 150 wastes a durable 220HP attacker when the sword line is short
hypotheses.pattern: bench-only ability engine; active only as designated wall

hypotheses.claim: gust (Boss's Orders) and lethal-detection ignore Doublade's real damage (display 0) so Boss's is used on wrong targets or lethal lines are missed.
hypotheses.direction: gust/lethal must reference the 60*hand_line_count formula so Doublade lethals and value-gusts are found

threshold.value: gust selects a target killable-this-turn (real damage) in >=80% of Boss's uses

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: restricting Boss's to guaranteed-kill only can forgo valuable tempo gusts (pull unloaded threats)
hypotheses.pattern: gust target selection by real-damage + prize EV

hypotheses.claim: Unconditional digging (Ultra Ball, Poffin, Poke Pad, Pokegear, Metallic Signal) thins the deck and loses to deckout in grindy games.
hypotheses.direction: search should stop when deck is thin and the board is established
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: stopping search too early leaves the deck unable to find its next attacker / evolution

hypotheses.claim: KO-post promotion picks the highest display damage Pokemon, promoting an unloaded Aegislash or a 2-prize Genesect ex into the active spot.
hypotheses.direction: promote a loaded single-prize attacker (Doublade with ammo / loaded Aegislash) over an unloaded main or Genesect ex
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing a loaded promotion may keep an unnecessary Genesect wall off the active spot when walling is correct

hypotheses.claim: Crispin / Enriching attach C-only energy (Dark, Enriching) onto attackers whose remaining need is a Metal slot, wasting the attachment.
hypotheses.direction: Dark(7)/Enriching(13) should fill Colorless slots only; Metal(8) reserved for M requirements

threshold.value: 0 C-only energy attached into an unmet M slot

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: rigid type rules can delay attaching any energy when only C-only energy is in hand
